    - `conda activate metagpt`
  - Install MetaGPT package:
    - Via PyPI: `pip install --upgrade metagpt`
    - Or install directly from GitHub:
      - `pip install --upgrade git+https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT.git`
      - Or clone repo and install in editable mode:
        - `git clone https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT && cd MetaGPT && pip install --upgrade -e .`
  - Configuration:
    - Initialize config with CLI: `metagpt --init-config` (creates `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml`)
    - Manually edit `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml` as needed based on example config at 
      `https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/blob/main/config/config2.example.yaml`
    - Typical required fields in config:
      ```yaml
      llm:
        api_type: "openai"  # or azure / ollama / open_llm etc.
        model: "gpt-4-turbo-preview"
        base_url: "https://api.openai.com/v1"
        api_key: "YOUR_API_KEY"
      ```
